description: A radar chart showing one month of training scores across six fitness areas.
overview: The basic `RadarChart`: a polygon `PolarGrid`, an angle axis for each skill and one filled `Radar` series. `chartData` has one record per axis (`skill`) with `thisMonth` and `lastMonth` scores. Only `thisMonth` is drawn. Pressing the chart shows a tooltip.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your records, set `PolarAngleAxis` `dataKey` to your axis field, and rename the series in `chartConfig`. The component takes no props.
